We are looking for a PhD student in Media Technology

This fully funded PhD studentship at Södertörn University in Stockholm, Sweden, offers an interdisciplinary opportunity to explore how digital technologies shape, and are shaped by, human experience and society. Spanning areas such as participatory and norm-critical design, maker practices, user experience, and the transformations of everyday life through digitalisation, it provides an opportunity not just to study technology, but to actively contribute to more inclusive and reflective digital futures.

The application deadline is 3 June 2026
